highest.description: Highest value for the coloring strategy.

lowest.description: Lowest value for the coloring strategy.

title:
A type that represents the manual coloring strategy configuration of a {@link UiSdlHeatMapColorFieldSetting}.
User can set high/low for the scale and all values are colored based on distance from those ends.
Values above or below the high/low would get the same color as the extreme colors.
name: UiSdlHeatMapManualColorSetting
